records.channelDescription:
Health stories for adults over 65, told through one small lake town.

On Birch Lane in Minnesota, Ansel and Marion Brooks and their neighbors live through the moments that matter after 65: the 3 a.m. trip to the bathroom, the bedroom that's too cold, the flu that won't let go, the new pill on the counter, the step you didn't see.

Each episode follows one of them through an everyday situation and turns published research into plain steps: the warning signs worth a call today, a simple check you can do at home, and the questions to bring to your own doctor or pharmacist.

Topics: falls and balance, sleep, heart and stroke warning signs, bladder and bowels, eyesight, medicines, surgery and tests, and winter safety.

Ansel, Marion and the Birch Lane neighbors are fictional characters. Stories are narrated with an AI voice and the pictures are AI-generated. Nobody on this channel is a doctor, and nothing here is medical advice. Talk with your doctor before changing any medicine.

records.text:
Six days after the midterms, Trump found a new reason he lost, offered the White House press secretary job to the head of the UFC, and then said he was only kidding. Jimmy Kimmel, Seth Meyers and Jimmy Fallon kept the receipts, and we kept count of the excuses. He gets to six.

Along the way: the White House puts out a second official statement about Jimmy Kimmel (this one goes after his brain), Ted Cruz finds grief at a Best Buy, there turn out to be two Dana Whites, and the real one gives his answer in front of the cameras inside the White House. Plus bad messaging, the 60 Minutes question about what history will say, and a State of the Union with a jackhammer.

What will excuse number seven be? Give us your best guess in the comments, and subscribe for the next one.

Chapters:
0:00 "I was kidding"
0:51 Six Days Late
2:42 Grief Counseling
4:12 White House vs. Kimmel: Round Two
5:55 Raccoon In A Duffel Bag
9:30 The Wrong Dana White
12:41 His Own Press Secretary
14:22 60 Minutes, Round Two

Sources:
• Jimmy Kimmel Live! (ABC): monologue of Nov. 9, 2026
• Late Night with Seth Meyers (NBC): Nov. 9, 2026
• The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon (NBC): Nov. 9, 2026
• President Trump's posts and the White House statement on Jimmy Kimmel, as read on Jimmy Kimmel Live
• 60 Minutes (CBS): interview with President Trump by Ross Douthat, as played on the shows above
• Photos: official presidential portrait (public domain); Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA)

Independent commentary and criticism. Not affiliated with ABC, NBC, CBS, any show, campaign or party. Short clips are used for commentary, criticism and news reporting under fair use.

#JimmyKimmel #Trump #DanaWhite #SethMeyers #JimmyFallon #LateNight #Kimmel #TrumpNews #Comedy
